content: React large-table guidance (multi-source, 2026): pagination is the simplest low-memory approach when users do not need the full dataset at once; virtualization (TanStack Virtual/react-window) only pays off for smooth scrolling through tens of thousands of rows; 50-row pages over a 4,912-row array render trivially fast; memoize row components and slice the page array to avoid re-mounting all rows.
